purpose: Keep ABBA from terminating useful work at a finite choice boundary; every decision set exposes a terminal choose-all path and a governed continuation loop.

terminalChoice.label: Choose all
terminalChoice.meaning: Select all currently eligible options in the decision set, then continue into dependency ordering, validation, execution planning, and follow-on recommendations.
notMeaning: not permission to execute unsafe or out-of-scope work
not a guarantee that every option is independently executable

afterSelection: execute or queue only permitted work
append newly eligible work to the queue
repeat until convergence or a governed stop condition

recommendationLoop.rule: ABBA should proactively identify useful next jobs rather than waiting for a new user prompt, while preserving authority, consent, scope, policy, risk, and resource boundaries.

orderingRules: required capability coverage before optional enrichment
high-risk work only after prerequisite evidence and authority gates
idempotent work may be retried according to retry policy
parallelizable independent work may be grouped internally but must remain separately attributable
completion must be recorded before follow-on jobs are promoted
sequencing.contextRule: Pass only the minimum context required for the current job and its authorization/evidence requirements.
